# Code of conduct

TinyMails contributors should be direct, patient, and respectful.

We welcome people regardless of experience, identity, disability, nationality, appearance, race, religion, or sexual orientation. Harassment, threats, unwanted sexual attention, doxxing, and sustained personal attacks are not acceptable.

Discuss the work. Critique code and decisions with specific evidence. Do not turn disagreement into judgment about a person. Respect requests to stop an interaction.

Repository maintainers may edit or remove contributions and restrict participation when behavior makes the project unsafe or unproductive.

## Reporting

TinyMails is maintained by [@Gauthi3r](https://github.com/Gauthi3r).

To report conduct that happened in this repository, use [GitHub's report abuse form](https://github.com/contact/report-abuse) and name the repository. That route reaches GitHub directly, so it also works when a report concerns the maintainer.

Do not put credentials, contact lists, or other people's email addresses in a report. Describe what happened and link to the issue, pull request, or comment.

Maintainers should protect the reporter's privacy and respond in proportion to the behavior.
